'''Vij Markos''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Markos was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he discovered an ancient and powerful being, named [[Elshuu]], imprisoned in Belsavis thousands of years ago. He believed that the Elshuu's [[Disciples of Elshuu|fanatical disciples]] had awoken and were trying to free their master. He tasked a Republic spacer to confront Elshuu and ensure he never escaped Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" />
